steps.caption: Photo Optimizer
steps.narration: This is the Photo Optimizer. It gives a batch of job photos a watermark, photo details and clear filenames.

steps.caption: Business info
steps.narration: Choose Business info to open the details every photo will carry.

steps.caption: Find your business on Google
steps.narration: Search your business on Google to fill them in, or type them in below.

steps.caption: Written into each photo's details
steps.narration: The name, address, website and your copyright line go into each photo's details.

steps.caption: Service area cities
steps.narration: Turn on Service area cities to find the towns around your address and work them into the photos.

steps.caption: Category and keywords
steps.narration: Pick your category and keywords. They become part of each filename.

steps.caption: Drop in the photos
steps.narration: Drag in your job photos, up to ten per batch, or choose Browse files.

steps.caption: Your name or logo on every photo
steps.narration: Watermark stamps your company name or logo on every photo, at the opacity you choose.

steps.caption: Process photos
steps.narration: Then choose Process photos. Download the results, or keep them in the Media Library.

steps.caption: Media Library
steps.narration: The Media Library keeps a folder per job, with the job address and GPS on it.

steps.caption: A folder with its address and GPS
steps.narration: This one is a job site in Highland, Denver, with its coordinates attached.

steps.caption: Open a folder
steps.narration: Open a folder to see its photos.

steps.caption: Named for the company, the work and the area
steps.narration: Every photo is named for the company, the work and the area, not a camera number.

steps.caption: Menu: Photo Optimizer
steps.narration: You'll find Photo Optimizer in the menu on the left, under Google Business, with Media Library under it.

youtube.title: Photo Optimizer in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of the Photo Optimizer in ConstructHUB: fill in your business details, pick service areas and keywords, drop in a batch of job photos, watermark them, and keep the named, geotagged results in Media Library folders by job.
